title: 第171章 狡兔死，走狗烹！
slug: 满级小李飞刀我在水浒当判官
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

原来，巫族一直在秘密搜集“仙魔之地”死去之人的尸体，以待战争时，运用“招魂术”招回他们的灵魂，再对灵魂加以束缚和巫化，使他们成为战争的工具。

想到这里，音铃心中的愤怒已到了极点，她幻化出天聪剑，迎击再次挥剑而来的石敬，只一招，便挑开了石敬的手腕，又使出一个回旋踢，对准石敬的腹部重重的踢出一脚，将他踢出几十米远，重重摔在了地上。

许久后，司机悠悠转醒，发现‘郤冰晴’不见了，慌乱的拨打了家里的电话。

乌篷船上百米外的海域上，吸血藤妖正在和佘吞海血战，双方都伤得不轻。

几次的恐怖袭击后，付炎不是没有想过反击，只是他根本不知道该怎么去反击，去哪里反击。

人们失声惊叫，话音未落，簇拥在甘清风身边的几个高手就全都被一掌震飞，然后，几个落神宫弟子失声尖叫起来。眨眼之间，甘清风就到了她们面前，手里碧玉萧血染般通红，杀气腾腾十足一个无人能挡的杀神。

付炎无时无刻不在寻找着可乘之机，听到电话有可能是那边打来的，付炎连忙集中了精神，穿过雨声，风声，海浪声将自己的听力延伸到了刘哥的电话那边。

汇德远一听着慌了，立刻风驰电掣出去了，又一转眼回到炼制现场，手里一盆清水在荡漾。

在场的学生，全神贯注的盯着屏幕，一直在等候林峰的安排，一听到林峰有新的指示，学生马上就挂单出去。

宫殿之内，两人一愣，相视一眼皆是像外冲去！却只见肖凌和璃怅两人，已然缓缓落下。

“因我不喜欢她，所以她是蛇……别动！这一处还没有擦到。”臭呆子，为了向她撒娇，把自己热出了痱子，委实不该管他。

content_en:
Page (1/3)

It turns out that the witch clan has been secretly collecting the corpses of the dead in the "Land of Immortals and Demons" in order to wait for the war. They use "spiritualism" to recall their souls, and then bind and witch the souls to make them tools of war.

Thinking of this, the anger in Yin Ling's heart reached the extreme. She transformed into a Tiancong sword and faced Shi Jing, who was swinging the sword again. With just one move, she opened Shi Jing's wrist, then used a roundhouse kick, aiming at Shi Jing's abdomen with a heavy kick. He was kicked dozens of meters away and fell heavily to the ground.

After a long time, the driver woke up leisurely and found that 'Que Bingqing' was missing. He called his home phone number in a panic.

On the sea a hundred meters away from the awning boat, the vampire vine demon was fighting a bloody battle with She Tunhai, and both sides were seriously injured.

After several terrorist attacks, it was not that Fu Yan had never thought about fighting back, but he simply didn't know how or where to fight back.

People screamed in alarm. Before they could finish speaking, several masters surrounding Gan Qingfeng were all knocked away by a palm. Then, several disciples of Luo Shen Palace screamed.In the blink of an eye, Gan Qingfeng was in front of them, with the jade in his hand as red as blood, full of murderous intent, an unstoppable god of death.

Fu Yan was always looking for opportunities. Hearing that the call might be coming from there, Fu Yan quickly concentrated his attention and extended his hearing through the sound of rain, wind and waves to reach Brother Liu's phone.

Hui Deyuan panicked when he heard this, and immediately rushed out, then returned to the refining site in the blink of an eye, with a basin of water rippling in his hand.

The students present were staring at the screen intently, waiting for Lin Feng's arrangements. As soon as they heard Lin Feng's new instructions, the students immediately placed their orders and left.

Inside the palace, the two of them were stunned, looked at each other and rushed out!But only Xiao Ling and Li Xuan were seen falling slowly.

"Because I don't like her, so she's a snake... don't move! This spot hasn't been touched yet." The idiot, in order to act coquettishly to her, got a prickly heat on himself, so he really shouldn't be cared about.
